entities.name: Peter Parker
entities.description: The original Spider-Man, a young man with a brilliant scientific mind who gained spider-powers from a radioactive spider bite and sells photos of Spider-Man. He struggles with lateness, rent and bad luck.

entities.name: Aunt May
entities.description: Peter Parker's aunt, who cooks him wheatcakes and always welcomes him home.

entities.name: Flash Thompson
entities.description: A Spider-Man fan whose obsession is mocked by Liz Allan.

entities.name: Agent Venom
entities.description: Corporal Thompson, who was wounded in action and offered an experimental way to be all he could be.

entities.name: Liz Allan
entities.description: A classmate who tells Flash no one cares about his Spider-Man obsession.

entities.name: George Stacy
entities.description: A police captain who finds it odd that Peter always disappears when Spider-Man is around.

entities.name: Silver Sable
entities.description: A mercenary leader who commands the Wild Pack and doesn't accept second best.

entities.name: Wild Pack
entities.description: Silver Sable's mercenary squad.

entities.name: Jessica Drew
entities.description: Spider-Woman, who tells a young hero he has a lot to learn.

entities.name: Spider-UK
entities.description: A Spider who seeks to keep the Spiders of the Multiverse safe as they are dying.

entities.name: Miles Morales
entities.description: A Spider-Man who is creating an all-new legacy and works with Peter Parker.

entities.name: Staten Island
entities.description: Borough threatened in peril, served by the passenger ferry.

entities.name: Chameleon

entities.name: Sinister Six
entities.description: A villain team associated with Doctor Octopus.

entities.name: Quentin Beck

events.summary: Peter Parker is bitten by a glowing radioactive spider.
events.quote: Ow! A spider! It bit me! But why is it glowing that way?

events.summary: Curt Connors regrows his arm with lizard DNA and transforms into the Lizard.
events.quote: Dr. Curt Connors used lizard DNA to regrow his missing arm, but it didn't stop there.

events.summary: Eddie Brock and his symbiote join together as Venom.
events.quote: I've got the nose for the story. He's got the hunger for the kill. Together...
Anyone who's tired of the slammer, follow us!

events.summary: Harry Osborn is urged to take the Goblin mask and avenge, and becomes the Green Goblin.
The Spider-Queen begins the metamorphosis of Manhattan with Professor Warren.
events.quote: We've done it, Professor Warren. The glorious metamorphosis of Manhattan has begun!

events.summary: Yuri Watanabe uses impounded tech to become the vigilante Wraith.
events.quote: Using tech impounded from her various arrests, Captain Yuri Watanabe took the law into her own hands.

events.summary: The Web-Warriors join forces to mend the severed skeins across time and space.
events.quote: Together, this group of amazing friends joined forces to mend the severed skeins across time and space.

events.summary: Otto Octavius resolves to become the Superior Spider-Man.
events.quote: I will be Spider-Man. With my unparalleled genius, I shall become the *Superior* Spider-Man.

events.summary: Wounded Corporal Thompson accepts an experimental treatment, becoming Agent Venom.
events.quote: Wounded in action, Corporal Thompson was offered an experimental way to be all he could be.

events.summary: The Enigma Force grants Peter cosmic power.
events.quote: The Enigma Force granted Peter the greatest power, and with it, the greatest responsibility.

events.summary: Gwen's Web Watch opens a portal and her allies across the Great Web pour forth.
events.quote: The device crackled to life, the portal opened, and Gwen's allies across the Great Web poured forth.

events.summary: Tony Stark sends Peter the Iron Spider suit.
events.quote: Peter appreciated the powerful new suit sent by Tony Stark, but he soon found it came with some strings attached.

events.summary: Spider-Man and Johnny Storm upgrade the Spider-Mobile.
events.quote: With Johnny Storm's help, Spider-Man took the all-terrain vehicle to the next level.

events.summary: Spider-Man declares he is giving up being Spider-Man.
events.quote: Being Spider-Man has brought me nothing but unhappiness! And for what?

events.summary: Frances Barrison becomes Shriek after exposure to the Darkforce dimension.
events.quote: Exposure to the Darkforce dimension left Frances Barrison craving chaos and carnage.
